source: Installed Steam Resident Evil 3 Remake patched PAK resources; game labels belong to CAPCOM.
parser: IntelOrca.Biohazard.REE 1.6.0, embedded RE3RT file list and RE3 RSZ schema
mapping: MiniMapId to scene key and FloorId comes from EsUIMapFloor*.UIMapFloorIdList.
FloorId to region GUID comes from EsUIMapFloorIdUserData.UIMapLocationList.FloorList/MapTabNameId.
Room labels join exact stNN_NNNN stem from floor Description with mes_map Map_stNN_NNNN message key.
Composite scene ID and AreaId to MiniMapId comes from EsMapIdChanger*.UIMapIdChanger.
LocationId fallback is supplied only when all named map members of MapStructureUserData.MyLocation agree; multi-region locations intentionally have no broad fallback.
Missing, rejected, dummy and zero-ID map rows are omitted; unknown mappings remain empty so caller can preserve raw IDs.
Engine formatting tags such as <ENT> are replaced with spaces and whitespace is collapsed for presence labels.
Weapon 0 is native BareHand; Nothing is an application label, not extracted text.

labels.english: Go to the rooftop parking lot
Get batteries from safety deposit room
Use the control panel to restore power
Bring the trains online in the subway office
Lure the creature away from the subway station

enumEvidence.source: Installed re3.exe TDB enum initializer pool exported by work/re3-enums.json
notes: Character names use explicit CARLOS/JILL aliases, not enum order. Other NPC and inherited RE2 survivor types remain unknown.
Difficulty casing normalized from all-capitals English labels. Unlimited is the Inferno gameplay mode; its English label key retains SuperHardPlus naming.
